issues.description: default_raise() sentinel pattern is dead scaffolding now that kw_only=True is unconditional.
issues.detail: default_raise + field(default_factory=default_raise) existed only as a pre-3.10 workaround so kw-only-like fields could appear without a real default. With kw_only=True universal, these fields are simply required; the runtime-raising factory complects 'required' with 'defaulted' and defers a TypeError to a RuntimeError. Drop default_factory and let dataclass enforce required kwargs.

issues.description: Stale '< 3.10 compatibility' comments and pragmas remain after the workaround was removed.
issues.detail: Comments above TransactionEndpointRequest and on default_raise still announce a pre-3.10 constraint that no longer exists. These fossils mislead the next reader about what invariant the code preserves. Either delete the patterns or rewrite the comments to describe the current kw-only required-field intent.

issues.description: Stray 'dnf search python3.12' left in CI provisioning steps.
issues.detail: dnf search only prints matches and does not install or gate anything; the subsequent dnf install would fail with a clearer error if the package were missing. It pollutes CI logs, looks like debug residue, and complects diagnostics with provisioning. Delete it, or replace with an explicit 'dnf list installed' assertion after install.

issues.description: Amazon/Rocky yum-to-dnf migration is bundled into the 3.9-drop commit.
issues.detail: The install scripts quietly switch package managers in the same patch that removes 3.9. That is an independent change; bundling it harms future bisects on install-script breakage. Split the dnf migration into its own commit so the 3.9-drop stays mechanical.

issues.description: PR description claims a Ruff Union typing change that does not appear in the diff.
issues.detail: The description says Union 'will soon not be supported through Ruff' but the diff touches no Ruff config and performs no Union-to-pipe rewrites. Either land the Ruff rule change here or drop the bullet from the description. Commit-message-vs-diff mismatch wastes the next reader's time.

issues.description: install.sh version-gate message says '>= 3.10' but the check still uses PYTHON_MINOR_VER < 7.
issues.detail: The conditional enforces minor >= 7 while the error message announces minor >= 10. A reader auditing the script sees two disagreeing invariants, and Python 3.7-3.9 silently pass the gate. Tighten the check to -lt 10 so code matches the message.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a sound, mechanical Python 3.9-floor bump: CI matrices, installers, and docs lose 3.9; kw_only=True becomes unconditional; zip(x, x[1:]) becomes itertools.pairwise. The cleanup, however, is half-finished — the default_raise/default_factory sentinel pattern and its '< 3.10 compatibility' comments are now fossils that lie about why they exist, and should be removed with the constraint they encoded. Scope discipline also slipped: the install scripts quietly migrate Amazon/Rocky from yum to dnf and leave a no-op 'dnf search python3.12' in CI, while the PR description promises a Ruff Union change that never appears in the diff. Verdict: merge-ready in spirit, but needs a follow-up pass to delete the dead scaffolding, drop the dnf search noise, and reconcile description with diff.
